sanskrit: ahaṃ vā indramātaram indraojām indrabhrātaram | indrādhivaktrāṃ vīrudham āhārṣaṃ viṣadūṣaṇīm ||
english: I have brought hither the herb that is Indra's mother, Indra's strength, Indra's sister — the herb that speaks under Indra's patronage — the poison-destroyer.

sanskrit: yat kiṃ ca padvac chaphavad yat kāṇḍi yac ca puṣpavat | yad ejati prajāpatiḥ sarvaṃ tad viṣadūṣaṇam ||
english: Whatever moves on feet, whatever has hooves, whatever has a stalk, whatever has blossoms, whatever Prajāpati causes to stir — all that is a poison-neutralizer.

sanskrit: sindhuḥ paścād dharuṇaḥ sūryasyodayanaṃ puraḥ | tato yad antarā viṣaṃ tad vācā dūṣayāmasi ||
english: The Sindhu river stands as support behind; the rising of the sun stands ahead — the poison that lies between those two, that we corrupt with our utterance.

sanskrit: yāvat sūryo vitapati yāvac cābhi vipaśyati | tāvad viṣasya dūṣaṇaṃ vaco nir mantrayāmahe ||
english: As far as the sun blazes, as far as it looks out upon all — over that whole extent we chant forth the corruption of poison.

sanskrit: jihvā me madhusaṃsrāvā jihvā me madhuvādinī | jihve varcasvatī bhava māyaṃ me puruṣo riṣat ||
english: My tongue flows with sweetness; my tongue speaks sweetness. O tongue, become possessed of brilliance — let not this man of mine come to harm.

sanskrit: hā hai kalyāṇi subhage pṛśniparṇy anāture | imaṃ me adya pūruṣaṃ dīrghāyutvāyon naya ||
english: Hā! Hai! O auspicious, blessed, healthy Pṛśniparṇī — lead this man of mine today toward long life!

sanskrit: yābhyo varṣanti vṛṣṭayo yābhir jīvanty aghnyāḥ | tā me viṣasya dūṣaṇīḥ savitā vy akāśayat ||
english: Those by whom the rains rain down, those by whom the inviolable cows live — Savitṛ has illumined those as my poison-corrupters.

sanskrit: prajāpatiṣ ṭvā badhnāt prathamam astṛtaṃ vīryāya kam | taṃ te badhnāmy āyuṣe varcasa ojase ca balāya ca- -astṛtas tvābhi rakṣatu ||
english: Prajāpati first bound you, the unvanquished one, for valor. I bind that one upon you for life, for brilliance, for might, and for strength. May the unvanquished one protect you on all sides.

sanskrit: ūrdhvas tiṣṭha rakṣann apramādam astṛtemaṃ mā tvā dabhan paṇayo yātudhānāḥ | indra iva dasyūn ava dhūnuṣva pṛtanyataḥ sarvāñ chatrūn vi ṣahasva- -astṛtas tvābhi rakṣatu ||
english: Stand upright, guarding alertly, O unvanquished one. Let not the Paṇis, let not the Yātudhānas deceive you. Shake off the assailants as Indra shakes off the Dasyus; overpower all enemies who would fight you. May the unvanquished one protect you on all sides.

sanskrit: śataṃ cana praharanto 'bhighnanto na tastrire | tasminn indraḥ pary adatta cakṣuḥ prāṇam atho balam astṛtas tvābhi rakṣatu ||
english: Even a hundred striking and smiting him could not exhaust him. Upon him Indra has bestowed sight, breath, and strength. May the unvanquished one protect you on all sides.

sanskrit: indrasya tvā varmaṇā pari dhāpayāmo yo devānām adhirājo babhūva | puras tvā devāḥ pra ṇayantu sarve 'stṛtas tvābhi rakṣatu ||
english: We clothe you about with the armor of Indra, who became the high king of the gods. May all the gods lead you forward. May the unvanquished one protect you on all sides.

sanskrit: asmin maṇāv ekaśataṃ vīryāṇi sahasraṃ prāṇā asminn astṛte | vyāghraḥ śatrūn adhi tiṣṭha sarvān yas tvā pṛtanyād adharaḥ so 'stv astṛtas tvābhi rakṣatu ||
english: In this amulet reside one hundred heroic powers; in this unvanquished one a thousand life-breaths. Stand over all enemies like a tiger — whoever would fight you, let him be the lower one. May the unvanquished one protect you on all sides.

sanskrit: ghṛtād ullupto madhumān payasvān sahasraprāṇaḥ śatayonir vayodhāḥ | śambhūś ca mayobhūś ca- -ūrjasvāṃś ca payasvāṃś ca- -astṛtas tvābhi rakṣatu ||
english: Anointed with ghee, sweet, full of nourishment, possessing a thousand life-breaths, having a hundred birthplaces, bestowing vigor — both benevolent and bliss-giving, both vigorous and rich in sap. May the unvanquished one protect you on all sides.

sanskrit: yathā tvam uttaro aso asapatnaḥ sapatnahā | sajātānām aso vaśī tathā tvā savitā karad astṛtas tvābhi rakṣatu ||
english: As you shall be the highest, without a rival, the slayer of rivals, the master of those born together — so may Savitṛ make you. May the unvanquished one protect you on all sides.

sanskrit: apaś ca rapaś ca- -ūṣmā ca bāṣpaś ca | śokaś cābhiśokaś ca tṛtīyekaś ca pareparaś ca takmāna ito naśyata ||
english: The watery kind and the spotted kind, the burning kind and the steaming kind; the painful kind and the severe kind, the tertian kind and the ever-recurring kind — O fever demons, vanish from here!

sanskrit: veda vai te takman nāma- -agniṣ ṭvaṃ nāmāsi | taṃ tveto vi nayāmaḥ śani takmā ||
english: I know your name, O Takman — you are named Fire. We lead you away from here as a gentle fever.

sanskrit: vṛtrasya haro 'si nabhaso napāt | dyauś cāsmat pṛthivī ca takmānaṃ nāśayatām itaḥ ||
english: You are the burning heat of Vṛtra; you are the offspring of the cloud. May Heaven and Earth destroy the fever from here.

sanskrit: pañcapsinir nāma te mātā sa u ekapsinir ucyase | tasyāhaṃ veda te nāma sa takman nir ato drava ||
english: Your mother is named Pañcapsinī; and you yourself are called Ekapsinī. I know your name — therefore, O Takman, run away from here!

sanskrit: audumbaraś ca nāmāsi priyātithiś ca | taṃ tveto nāśayāmasi brahmaṇā vīryāvatā ||
english: And you are named Audumbara; and you are named Priyātithi. We destroy you hence with powerful sacred utterance.

sanskrit: yo 'si jalpaṃś ca lapaṃś ca- -āvāṃ ca tapaṃś ca | tṛtīyekaś ca mauñjigalaś ca te takmāna ito naśyata ||
english: The chattering kind and the babbling kind, the dampening kind and the burning kind; the tertian kind and the Mauñjigala kind — O fever demons, vanish from here!

sanskrit: vikilīda vilohita vikāśakraṃdarajjana | giriṃ gaccha dhūmaketo hṛṣe namāṃsi santu te ||
english: O Vikilīda, O Vilohita, O Vikāśa, O Kraṃdarajjana — go to the mountain, O Dhūmaketu! Let homages be made to you in the forest.

sanskrit: bṛhat tvam agne rakṣo adhamaṃ jahi madhyamaṃ ny uttamaṃ śṛṇīhi | śaṃ no agnir jyotiranīko astu śaṃ dyāvāpṛthivī anehasā ||
english: O Agni, the mighty one, slay the lowest demon, cast down the middling one, crush the highest. May Agni, whose face is light, be benevolent to us; may Heaven and Earth be benevolent to us without fail.

sanskrit: māteva pitevābhi rakṣatainaṃ muñcatainaṃ pary aṃhasaḥ ||
english: Like a mother, like a father — protect him, release him from distress on all sides.
